proof_body:
by
  intro f U c hU hp hc hf hm
  have hg : DifferentiableOn ℂ (fun z => Complex.exp (f z)) U := hf.cexp
  have hmax : IsMaxOn (norm ∘ fun z => Complex.exp (f z)) U c := by
    intro z hz
    simp only [Set.mem_setOf_eq, Function.comp_apply, Complex.norm_exp]
    exact Real.exp_le_exp.mpr (hm z hz)
  have he := Complex.eqOn_of_isPreconnected_of_isMaxOn_norm hp hU hg hc hmax
  have hd : Set.EqOn (deriv f) 0 U := by
    intro x hx
    have hxn := hU.mem_nhds hx
    have h1 : HasDerivAt (fun z => Complex.exp (f z)) (Complex.exp (f x) * deriv f x) x := (hf.differentiableAt hxn).hasDerivAt.cexp
    have h2 : HasDerivAt (fun z => Complex.exp (f z)) 0 x := by
      have : (fun z => Complex.exp (f z)) =ᶠ[nhds x] fun _ => Complex.exp (f c) := by
        filter_upwards [hxn] with y hy using he hy
      exact (hasDerivAt_const x _).congr_of_eventuallyEq this
    have h3 := h1.unique h2
    exact (mul_eq_zero.mp h3).resolve_left (Complex.exp_ne_zero _)
  intro z hz
  exact hU.is_const_of_deriv_eq_zero hp hf hd hz hc
target_source: ∀ (f : ℂ → ℂ) (U : Set ℂ) (c : ℂ), IsOpen U → IsPreconnected U → c ∈ U → DifferentiableOn ℂ f U → (∀ z ∈ U, (f z).re ≤ (f c).re) → ∀ z ∈ U, f z = f c
